channel.title: Crypto Daybook
channel.description: Crypto Daybook reports daily crypto news: market moves, Bitcoin and Ethereum updates, exchange and protocol developments, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: Dutch central bank authorises Qivalis to issue euro tokens
item.description: Qivalis won Dutch e-money authorisation, clearing a key step toward its euro stablecoin, but MiCA requirements and a white paper remain before issuance.

item.title: ParaSwap: How to choose a cross-chain swap route
item.description: A cross-chain route trades cost, speed and complexity. Compare the full path, check the receiving token and leave room for destination-chain gas before you swap.

item.title: Binance opens AI trading interface after 150,000-user beta
item.description: Binance has rolled out its AI interface after a beta with about 150,000 testers, adding tailored market summaries and alerts while more languages are still coming.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes bug that could have created 18 trillion XRP
item.description: XRPL developers patched a payment bug that could have created spendable XRP beyond the ledger’s 100 billion supply; no public-network exploit was found.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, with six slated for $1 million each, as a stalled Senate bill leaves crypto market rules unresolved.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House candidates from both parties, including six with $1 million each, as the stalled CLARITY Act leaves crypto rules unresolved.

item.title: ESMA opens review of tokenised collateral for EU clearing
item.description: ESMA has opened a call for evidence on tokenised collateral at EU clearing houses, asking how it can be handled safely and setting a 15 January 2027 deadline.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Crypto super PAC Fairshake will back 32 House incumbents, including six with $1 million each, as the Senate’s CLARITY Act stalls ahead of November’s midterms.

item.title: Wells Fargo and Kraken owner Payward discuss crypto liquidity
item.description: Wells Fargo is discussing crypto trading liquidity with Kraken owner Payward, a possible route for the bank to offer crypto trading to clients.

item.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade activates on Sepolia
item.description: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade activated on Sepolia, giving developers a live test of changes to block building, data access and the network’s gas limit.

item.title: Wormhole bridge routes: how to choose where your token goes
item.description: A Wormhole bridge transfer can return wrapped or native tokens depending on the route; check the destination chain, token form and completion steps before sending.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House candidates, including six with $1 million each, as the crypto industry looks to revive stalled market rules in the next Congress.

item.title: Polymarket tests V2 with one positions contract and pUSD
item.description: Polymarket has begun testing Protocol V2 on live markets, bringing positions into one contract and using pUSD collateral ahead of a planned November switch for new markets.

item.title: SushiSwap: Choose a Swap or a Liquidity Pool
item.description: SushiSwap can handle a one-off token trade or a longer-term pool position; the right choice depends on the assets, effort and risks you can take.

item.title: HIFI raises $37 million to expand tokenized markets
item.description: HIFI raised $37 million to extend its stablecoin platform into cards and capital markets, funding tools for firms to settle tokenized assets more easily.

item.title: Blast to wind down after value locked falls more than 98%
item.description: Blast will wind down its Ethereum layer-2 after costs overtook revenue; users can withdraw through its interface until Oct. 26 as value locked sits near $32 million.

item.title: Can a Token Bridge Send Funds to a Different Address?
item.description: A token bridge can send funds to a different destination address when its transfer flow allows it, but that address must work on the receiving chain.

item.title: Four Checks That Can Cut Omnichain Swap Inventory Costs
item.description: Swap providers can reduce inventory costs by forecasting demand, setting reserve limits, comparing full route costs and rebalancing only when the savings justify it.

item.title: Aave V4 Tops $1B in Deposits as Arc and Base Go Live
item.description: Aave says V4 passed $1 billion in deposits in September as Arc and Base went live, adding new lending markets and a way to borrow USDC against tokenized shares.

item.title: How Treasury Teams Reconcile BNB Token Payouts
item.description: Match each BNB payout to its on-chain record, separate transfer amounts from fees, and resolve gaps before closing the treasury ledger.
